function.arguments:
{"sql": "WITH top_g AS (
    SELECT player_id, g, row_number() OVER (ORDER BY g DESC) as rn
    FROM batting
    WHERE g IS NOT NULL
),
top_r AS (
    SELECT player_id, r, row_number() OVER (ORDER BY r DESC) as rn
    FROM batting
    WHERE r IS NOT NULL
),
top_h AS (
    SELECT player_id, h, row_number() OVER (ORDER BY h DESC) as rn
    FROM batting
    WHERE h IS NOT NULL
),
top_hr AS (
    SELECT player_id, hr, row_number() OVER (ORDER BY hr DESC) as rn
    FROM batting
    WHERE hr IS NOT NULL
)
SELECT 
    t1.player_id,
    t1.g as games_played,
    t2.r as runs,
    t3.h as hits,
    t4.hr as home_runs
FROM top_g t1
JOIN top_r t2 ON t1.player_id = t2.player_id AND t1.rn = t2.rn
JOIN top_h t3 ON t1.player_id = t3.player_id AND t1.rn = t3.rn
JOIN top_hr t4 ON t1.player_id = t4.player_id AND t1.rn = t4.rn;", "preview_rows": 50}
